answer: Patches are cut from old sails, and the patcher matches the weave so the repair disappears in the wind. Sail oakum cord maker net warrant governs the matching: a warrant oakum cord makers show after cord shop trials. The lagoon is the first weave matched, the willow the last before the patch is sewn, and the basalt is the sewing, slow and even in the lamplight. A forger would match 71 false weaves and sew 71 false patches.
